## Summary

<!-- One sentence describing what this PR adds/changes. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] New resource(s) added
- [ ] Resource updated (URL, status, description, etc.)
- [ ] Resource removed (deprecated/dead)
- [ ] New category file
- [ ] Site code change (component, page, styling)
- [ ] Documentation change

## For new/updated resources

- [ ] I edited the appropriate `src/data/categories/*.json` file
- [ ] I followed the schema in `src/data/schema.json`
- [ ] The URL is correct, reachable, and matches the upstream's canonical address
- [ ] I set an honest `status` (official / community / unofficial / deprecated)
- [ ] I checked the maintenance signal (active / stale / archived)
- [ ] The description is factual, neutral, and 1–3 sentences
- [ ] I am NOT adding personal-data sources, crypto integrations, or scrapers
      that violate the upstream's terms of service
